messages.content: What's the judgement in case XYZ?

function.name: law_firm_get_impactful_cases
function.description: Retrieve impactful cases handled by a specific law firm within a given year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: The year for which the cases are needed.

top_n.description: Number of top impactful cases. Default is 5.

message.content: I’m not sure which law firm handled case XYZ or what year it was decided. Could you let me know the name of the law firm involved and the year the case was adjudicated? That way I can pull up the relevant judgment details for you.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What's the judgement in case XYZ?" They want the judgement text or summary. We have no direct knowledge of case XYZ. We need to use the function law_firm_get_impactful_cases to retrieve impactful cases handled by a specific law firm within a given year. But we don't know the law firm name or year. The user didn't provide those. So we cannot call the function. We should ask clarifying question: Which law firm and year? Or maybe they want the judgement text. We can ask them to specify the law firm and year.
